svg.text: 100-bay heavy vehicle park with driver amenities
Great North Road (T2), Mkushi, Central Province

3. Levels in metres, relative to site datum

Re-planned: 101 bays on 1.80 ha; full set
Canopy: 203×203×46 UC columns on 1.2 × 1.2 × 1.0 pads; IPE 300 rafters, 3° mono-pitch to
rear gutter; 0.53 mm IBR; 1.0 m deep ACM-clad fascia with client signage; 8 × 150 W LED
canopy floods (100 lx at gate); clear height 5.50 m (≥ 4.30 m SADC max + 1.2 m).
ANPR + driver card / ticket at entry; payment at gatehouse or app
2 × 6.0 m arm, 3 s open, loop detection, anti-crush
2 × motorised cantilever, closed 22:00–05:00 except on call
24 h, 2 per shift; panic button to armed response
Fibre / LTE link, UPS 2 h, CCTV recording in Room 07
Totem 6 m at T2 (tariffs, capacity), RDA approval
